question: What will Argentina's month-on-month inflation (INDEC national CPI) be for October 2026?

calls.reasoning: Reference class: consensus of Argentine private consultoras one to two weeks before INDEC's release; they usually land within about ±0.2–0.3pp of the print. October estimates run 1.8%–2.1% (Equilibra, LCG and Libertad y Progreso at 1.8%; EconViews 1.9%; Analytica, Invecq and C&T about 2.0%). Fuel pass-through, gas tariffs and vegetables push up; flat meat and core near 1.6–1.8% push down. In September INDEC printed at the low end of the private range. Polymarket's near-miss bucket contracts (1.6–1.8% at 0.48, 1.9–2.1% at 0.38) lean slightly lower; I used them as evidence, not an anchor. Median 1.85%.
calls.dossier:
- INDEC 2026 monthly prints: Jan 2.9, Feb 2.9, Mar 3.4, Apr 2.6, May 2.1, Jun 1.9, Jul 2.1, Aug 1.7, Sep 1.9 (Sep release 13 Oct 2026; core 1.8, food 2.0).
- Private October estimates (Infobae 2 Nov 2026): Libertad y Progreso 1.8, Equilibra 1.8, EconViews 1.9, Analytica ~2.0, Invecq ~2.0, C&T ~2.0, EcoGo 2.1. Cronista lists EcoGo 1.8 and LCG 1.8 (LCG point-to-point 1.6); El Destape (30 Oct) lists EcoGo 1.8–2.0 and FIEL CABA 2.0.
- Equilibra (X): national 1.8, core 1.6, 'subyacente' 1.9.
- Analytica: food and beverages +2.5% over four weeks of October; vegetables +8.8%, fruit +2.9%. LCG: meat -0.6%, vegetables -1.1% in its last week; grains and pasta +2.4%.
- BCRA (29 Oct 2026): late-September fuel increase passes fully into October; gas tariffs rise in Oct/Nov as Zona Fría subsidies shrink; Q4 risks from beef seasonality and oil prices.
- September REM (published 6 Oct): median 1.7% for October. October REM not found at search time.
- September comparison: REM median 1.9; consultoras 1.9–2.1 (C&T 1.9, EcoGo/LyP 2.0, Equilibra 2.1); INDEC printed 1.9, the low end of the private range.
- Status quo: monthly prints between 1.7 and 2.1 since May.
- Resolves off INDEC national Nivel general m/m in the 12 Nov 2026 release, not CABA, core or REM.
- Event window: the October 2026 calendar month (already elapsed); release 12 Nov 2026; as of 2 Nov 100% of the price window has elapsed and the data is unpublished.
- Searched but not found: official CABA IPCBA October figure; October REM.
calls.reference_class: Private consultora consensus vs INDEC monthly CPI prints, 2025-2026

calls.reasoning: Reference: Oct 2026 private estimates cluster 1.8-2.0 (Equilibra/LyP/LCG 1.8, EconViews/C&T 1.9, Analytica/Empiria/Invecq 2.0, EcoGo 1.8-2.1); pre-month REM 1.7. Recent prints 1.7-2.1 since May. Upward drivers: full pass-through of late-Sept fuel hikes, vegetables/food firm, transport fares. Downward: fewer housing tariff adjustments, flat beef, core ~1.6 (Equilibra). Polymarket (thin, ~$10-15k vol, contract matches INDEC headline Oct 2026) prices 1.6-1.8 at 0.48 vs 1.9-2.1 at 0.38, slightly lower than consultoras; centre ~1.85. Private estimates' error SD ~0.2-0.3pp sets the width.
calls.dossier:
- Resolves off INDEC national IPC 'Nivel general' Oct 2026 m/m, release 12 Nov 2026 16:00 ART; not core, not regional, not CABA. Event window: Oct 2026 price month (fully elapsed); figure published 12 Nov; as of 2026-11-02 data period 100% elapsed, release pending.
- 2026 INDEC prints: Jan 2.9, Feb 2.9, Mar 3.4, Apr 2.6, May 2.1, Jun 1.9, Jul 2.1, Aug 1.7, Sep 1.9 (Sep core 1.8, food 2.0).
- BCRA REM Sep survey (pub 6 Oct): Oct median 1.7, Nov 1.6 (taken before October observed).
- Equilibra (X, ~1 Nov): national 1.8, core 1.6, underlying 1.9; seasonal 2.7 (vegetables +5.4), regulated 1.8 (public transport +3.3), beef ~0.1.
- Libertad y Progreso (La Nación 1 Nov): 1.8; food 2.1; housing 1.1 (from 3.1); transport 2.7 (fuel pass-through).
- LCG: 1.8; food above 2.5 but decelerating. EconViews: ~1.9, food 2.3. C&T: ~1.9 (GBA). Analytica & Empiria: 2.0, food 4-week avg 2.5, vegetables 8.8. Invecq ~2.0. EcoGo reported as 1.8 (La Nación) and 2.1 (Infobae), 1.9-2.0 with gas subsidy adjustments.
- BCRA monetary policy report (late Oct): late-Sep fuel hikes fully impact October; Q4 pressures from beef seasonality and regulated prices.
- Historical: private nowcasts vs INDEC errors typically ±0.2-0.3pp; INDEC prints in Aug-Sep 2026 came at/below private consensus in at least some months (not verified per month).
- Searched but not found: CABA October 2026 CPI (not yet published as of 2 Nov); October REM (due early Nov).
- Human market: Polymarket bucket contracts on Oct 2026 Argentina monthly inflation exist (thin volume).
calls.reference_class: Private consultora nowcasts of Argentina INDEC monthly CPI made days before release, 2025-2026, and their error vs the actual print

calls.reasoning: Private consultora nowcasts for Oct 2026 cluster 1.8-2.1% (mean ~1.93): LyP/Equilibra/LCG 1.8, EconViews 1.9, Analytica/Invecq/C&T 2.0, EcoGo 2.1; food (vegetables) and fuel pushed late-month. REM Sept median 1.7, top-10 1.8. Polymarket (matching buckets, ~$31k vol) prices 1.6-1.8 at 49% vs 1.9-2.1 at 39%, implying ~1.86 median. Recent INDEC prints 1.7-2.1. Median 1.9 with ~0.2pp error SD; small tails for regime surprises.

calls.reference_class: INDEC monthly CPI prints vs private consultora nowcast consensus, 2024-2026 (errors typically within +/-0.3pp)

calls.reasoning: October price month fully elapsed; private nowcasts cluster 1.8-2.1 (LyP/Equilibra/LCG 1.8, EconViews 1.9, Analytica/Invecq/C&T ~2.0, EcoGo 1.8-2.1). Upward: full pass-through of late-Sept fuel hikes, vegetables, gas subsidy cuts. Downward: core ~1.6 (Equilibra), flat beef, lower housing tariffs, INDEC printed at the low end of the private range in September, REM 1.7 (top-10 1.8). Polymarket matching buckets (thin, ~$25k) price 1.6-1.8 at 0.48 vs 1.9-2.1 at 0.38 -> median ~1.85. Median 1.87, SD ~0.22.
calls.reconciliation: The runs agree on the evidence and differ only on the median (1.85 vs 1.9). Factual disputes: EcoGo's estimate is reported as 1.8, 1.8-2.0 or 2.1 and can't be settled offline; it moves the consultora mean by only ~0.03pp. Polymarket volume is quoted as $10-15k or ~$31k; the harness candidate list shows $14.7k + $9.9k, so the market is thin, but the contract matches (INDEC national headline, Oct 2026). Judgment: the consultora mean of ~1.93 is weighed against September's low-end print, core at 1.6, REM top-10 at 1.8 and the market lean, giving a median of ~1.87. Width carried forward from the runs (0.56) because I agree with the nowcast-error basis.

disagreements.verdict: Can't be settled offline; sources conflict and the effect on the mean is small
Harness data shows ~$24.6k across the two buckets; thin either way
1.87: consultora mean ~1.93 pulled down by September's low-end print, core 1.6 and market lean
